title: The first challenges: a balance around 1850
goal: I can summarise the main challenges of the new republics around 1850.
grammar: Argument markers: summing up a balance

items: I can summarise the main challenges of the new republics around 1850.
I can say what Mexico lost in the war of 1846 to 1848.
I can explain why exporting raw materials made countries dependent.
I can say what Brazil did differently.
I can use en resumen, lo más importante es que and por un lado to organise an argument.
